headline.en: New paper: neural operator upsamples sparse HRTF measurements
headline.zh: 新论文：神经算子实现稀疏HRTF上采样

summary.en: This week adds one spatial-audio paper: SPARO, a neural operator that turns sparse HRTF measurements into a continuous field queryable in any direction. It reports lower log-spectral distortion and interaural level difference error than baselines on SONICOM and HUTUBS. No source projects were added.
summary.zh: 本周新增一篇空间音频论文：SPARO 用神经算子把稀疏的 HRTF 测量转换为可沿任意方向查询的连续场，并在 SONICOM 和 HUTUBS 数据集上报告了比基线更低的对数谱失真和双耳声级差误差。本周没有新增源码项目。

note.en: SPARO upamples sparse HRTF measurements into a continuous field that can be queried at arbitrary directions, and reports lower log-spectral distortion and interaural level difference error than baselines on SONICOM and HUTUBS.
note.zh: SPARO 将稀疏 HRTF 测量上采样为可按任意方向查询的连续场，在 SONICOM 与 HUTUBS 上报告的对数谱失真和双耳声级差误差均低于基线。
